name: spec16-20
source: docs/instinct-spec-series/16-messaging-native.md, 'The 20-text gauntlet' (verbatim texts, in order, one thread)
runs_against: the LIVE agent-chat handler only (evals/gauntlet/run-live.cjs --suite spec16)
grading: Mechanical checks per item (below); a person reads every reply in the raw log. Items that need an image send the photo in evals/gauntlet/media (synthetic fixtures from make-media.py, or the owner's own photos via --media-dir); with no photo they are NOT RUN and reported as such, never as passes.
